svg.title: GHC not required: AIHC bootstraps from a C compiler
svg.desc: A C compiler compiles aihc-bootstrap, a Haskell interpreter of 19,464 lines of C99. The interpreter runs AIHC from source, and that AIHC builds a native AIHC. All 1,665 object files are byte for byte those of a native AIHC building the same sources. The build takes 5.8 hours of processor time.

g.text: A C compiler in. AIHC out. No GHC.
a compiler that then compiles itself

svg.text: 91 packages at -O 0 · 76 from Hackage · sources pinned by SHA-256
